title: Zeplin artboard
intendedUserGoal: Review the client design artboard without critiquing Zeplin editor chrome.

strongFindings.rootCause: The hero image, heading, and CTA compete within the artboard.
Decorative quote treatment may compete with testimonial readability and credibility.

rootCauseObservations: The review must isolate the artboard and ignore Zeplin UI controls.
mergeGuidance: Findings about editor panels should be rejected unless the whole visible screen was selected.
scannerSpamToAvoid: Do not flag Zeplin navigation, specs, comments, or zoom controls.
